headline: Outcome of Board Meeting — ICICI Bank Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board at its meeting held today, inter alia, approved the filing of an application with RBI seeking its approval for the continuation of Mr. Pradeep Kumar Sinha as a Non-executive Part-time Chairpers
summary: ICICI Bank's board approved seeking RBI approval for the continuation of Pradeep Kumar Sinha as Non-executive Part-time Chairperson from July 1, 2027 till February 16, 2029.
raw_text: ICICI Bank Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board at its meeting held today, inter alia, approved the filing of an application with RBI seeking its approval for the continuation of Mr. Pradeep Kumar Sinha as a Non-executive Part-time Chairperson of the Bank for a further period from July 1, 2027 till February 16, 2029 which is within his tenure as Independent Director approved by the Board and shareholders. This information is being filed in continuation of the disclosures filed by the Bank on February 17, 2024 and May 24, 2024.

enrichment.background: The Board approved filing an application with the RBI seeking approval for the continuation of Mr. Pradeep Kumar Sinha as Non-executive Part-time Chairperson from July 1, 2027 till February 16, 2029, within his tenure as Independent Director approved by the Board and shareholders (Filing p. 1).

summary: Q2 FY27 (consolidated): Total income ₹88,161 Cr (+15.8% YoY, +10.6% QoQ); PAT ₹16,333 Cr (+22.3% YoY, +5.8% QoQ). Operating profit (ex-provisions) ₹24,010 Cr (+20.2% YoY).
